title: Winter sun from Leeds Bradford in February: direct flights compared
author: Brogan
intro: Leeds Bradford is Jet2's home airport, and its winter sun flights are the main reason Yorkshire flies from there between November and March. Here's where you can go direct in February, how long it takes and how warm each place usually is, including the new Red Sea flights.
seo_title: Winter sun from Leeds Bradford in February: 3 to 5½ hrs
seo_description: The Canaries are about 4½ hours from Leeds Bradford and 21-22°C in February. Jet2's new Egypt flights are warmer. Every direct option compared.

sections.heading: The short answer
sections.text:
- **Warm and close:** the Canaries, 4½ hrs
- **New this winter:** Jet2 to the Red Sea
- **Shortest flight:** Málaga or Faro
- **Leeds half term:** 15 to 19 Feb 2027

The temperatures are average February daytime highs from the climate figures in our guides. Flight times are typical direct times from Leeds Bradford. We checked routes in November 2026, but timetables and days change, so check the airline's own schedule for your dates before you book.

Morocco is normally an hour ahead of the UK, but it puts its clocks back for Ramadan, which is expected to start in early February 2027. So for much of February it's likely to be on UK time.

There are no long-haul flights from Leeds Bradford. For Dubai or the Caribbean, Manchester is the nearest airport with direct routes.

sections.heading: The Canaries: the easy choice
sections.text:
Jet2's winter programme from Leeds Bradford is built around the Canary Islands, which are the warmest beach weather in Europe in February, at about 21 to 22°C by day. They're on UK time, so there's no jet lag.

- **[Tenerife](/destinations/tenerife) and [Gran Canaria](/destinations/gran-canaria):** the most to do, with the sunniest resorts in the south of each island.
- **[Lanzarote](/destinations/lanzarote):** calmer, with volcanic scenery and low white villages.
- **[Fuerteventura](/destinations/fuerteventura):** long sandy beaches, though it's often windy.

February is carnival month too, and Santa Cruz de Tenerife's is one of the biggest in the world. Our [Tenerife or Lanzarote in winter](/blog/tenerife-or-lanzarote-in-winter) and [Gran Canaria or Tenerife](/blog/gran-canaria-or-tenerife) posts help you choose an island.

sections.heading: The Red Sea: new this winter
sections.text:
Jet2 has added flights from Leeds Bradford to [Sharm el-Sheikh](/destinations/sharm-el-sheikh) and [Hurghada](/destinations/hurghada) for winter 2026/27. At about 22 to 23°C in February, with sunshine nearly every day and coral reefs just offshore, they're the warmest option from Yorkshire this winter.

- **Sharm el-Sheikh:** the best snorkelling, with many hotels on their own house reef.
- **Hurghada:** bigger, often cheaper, and within reach of Luxor on a long day trip.

UK visitors need a visa for Egypt, usually bought online or on arrival, and Egypt is two hours ahead. Our [Hurghada or Sharm el-Sheikh](/blog/hurghada-or-sharm-el-sheikh-in-winter) post compares the two. Check GOV.UK's travel advice before you book.

sections.heading: Shorter flights: Spain, Portugal, Madeira and Morocco
sections.text:
- **[Málaga](/destinations/malaga) and the [Algarve](/destinations/algarve):** Ryanair flies to both all year and Jet2 flies to Málaga, about three hours away. At 17 to 18°C they're mild rather than hot, but good for a sunny city break, golf or coastal walks.
- **[Madeira](/destinations/madeira):** about 19°C and lovely for walking the levada paths, with February the start of the flower season.
- **[Marrakech](/destinations/marrakech):** about 20°C by day, but cold at night. Jet2 lists it as one of its top winter routes.

Watch out: these are mild, not hot, in February. Pack a warm layer for the evenings, and don't count on swimming in the sea.

sections.heading: February half term from Leeds Bradford
sections.text:
Leeds council schools have February half term from 15 to 19 February 2027. Academies, and schools in Bradford, Kirklees, Calderdale and North Yorkshire, can set different dates, so check with your school.

- **For the best prices:** go in the first two weeks of February, or the week after half term.
- **For a short break:** Málaga, Faro or Marrakech for three or four nights.
- **For a week of guaranteed warmth:** the Red Sea, or the south of Tenerife.

Tip: Leeds Bradford is a hilltop airport, and early-morning fog or snow can cause delays in February. Leave extra time on the roads, and see [how early to arrive at Leeds Bradford Airport](/blog/how-early-should-you-arrive-at-leeds-bradford-airport).

Our [February half term](/destinations/february-half-term-holidays) page has more ideas, and [where to go in February](/destinations/where-to-go-in-february) covers the whole month.

sections.heading: Where could you go from Leeds Bradford?
sections.text:
Start with [Tenerife](/destinations/tenerife) or [Lanzarote](/destinations/lanzarote) for an easy week, or [Sharm el-Sheikh](/destinations/sharm-el-sheikh) for real warmth. Our guide to [where you can fly direct from Leeds Bradford](/blog/where-can-you-fly-direct-from-leeds-bradford-airport) lists every route, including city breaks.

Can't agree? Add your favourites to somewhere.party, give everyone points to vote with, and let the draw choose.

faqs.question: Where is warmest in February with a direct flight from Leeds Bradford?
faqs.answer: Sharm el-Sheikh and Hurghada, at about 22 to 23°C, with Jet2's new flights this winter. The Canaries are close behind at 21 to 22°C, with a shorter flight and no time difference.

faqs.question: How long is the flight from Leeds Bradford to Tenerife?
faqs.answer: About four and a half hours direct. Lanzarote and Fuerteventura are slightly shorter.

faqs.question: When is February half term 2027 in Leeds?
faqs.answer: Leeds council schools have half term from 15 to 19 February 2027. Academies and schools in neighbouring council areas can set different dates, so check with your school.

faqs.question: Are there long-haul flights from Leeds Bradford?
faqs.answer: No. For Dubai, the USA or the Caribbean, Manchester is the nearest airport with direct long-haul flights.
